items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Joe and I fooled around and played the melody. We got the melody... the three of us got together and we wrote Too Late to Be Sorry Now.

ctx.x: And he was from out in Texas. You know what part of Texas? No, I really don't know.

Was he in town or something? How'd you meet him? It's possible that he sang because he had a marvelous voice. It's possible that he sang one of the places and that's where we met him. Joe Voyage just met him. And then the three of us got together and we wrote Too Late to Be Sorry Now. I think he wrote the lyrics. I think Joe and I fooled around and played the melody. We got the melody.
Well, on this record it has Therian's name.
